name: Free Cities carrier state before and after temporary AI custody comparison

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local x,y,free,building=114,45,62,12
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(x,y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==free and city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(building),'Free Cities official carrier missing')
local assets=A.CityAssets(city)
assert(assets.BUILDING_TEMPLE and assets.BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[0]~=nil,'carrier Temple slot absent')
assets.BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[0]=-1 -- only the intended original work differs
local plots={}
for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do
 local p=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i)
 if Map.GetPlotDistance(x,y,p:GetX(),p:GetY())<=2 then plots[tostring(i)]=p:GetOwner() end
end
local units={}
local owners,seen={},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[free] then owners[#owners+1]=free end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
 if Players[owner] then for _,unit in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if unit:GetX()==x and unit:GetY()==y then units[#units+1]={Owner=owner,ID=unit:GetID(),Type=GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].UnitType} end
 end end
end
local result={Owner=city:GetOwner(),X=x,Y=y,Name=city:GetName(),Population=city:GetPopulation(),
  Assets=assets,Loyalty=A.CityLoyalty(city),Religion=A.CityReligion(city),
  Faith=city:GetProperty(A.Rules.CITY_FAITH_KEY),Governance=city:GetProperty(A.Rules.GOVERNANCE_KEY),
  NearbyPlots=plots,UnitsOnCenter=units,FreeCityCount=Players[free]:GetCities():GetCount()}
print('[JAC_FREE_CARRIER_SIDE_EFFECT_'..tostring(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE') and 'AFTER' or 'BEFORE')..'] '..A.Canonical(result))
return 'Free Cities carrier baseline comparison recorded'
